sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，且尸体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: It is late afternoon, and the people of London are preparing for the night.
sentences.zh: 时值傍晚，伦敦市民们正在为夜晚做准备。

sentences.en: Everyone is anxious to get home before darkness falls, before our nightly visitors arrive.
sentences.zh: 每个人都急于在天黑前、在我们的“夜间访客”到来前赶回家。

sentences.en: The dusk is deepening.
sentences.zh: 暮色渐浓。

sentences.en: Listening crews are posted all the way from the coast to London to pick up the drone of the German planes.
sentences.zh: 从海岸到伦敦，监听人员已全部就位，准备捕捉德国飞机的轰鸣声。

sentences.en: Soon, the nightly Battle of London will be on.
sentences.zh: 很快，伦敦的夜间战役就要打响了。

sentences.en: This has been a quiet day for us, but it won't be a quiet night.
sentences.zh: 今天对我们来说是平静的一天，但夜晚注定不会平静。

sentences.en: The searchlights are in position, the guns are ready, the People's Army of Volunteers is ready.
sentences.zh: 探照灯已就位，高射炮已准备就绪，人民志愿军也已整装待发。

sentences.en: They are the ones who are really fighting this war.
sentences.zh: 他们才是真正参与这场战争的人。

sentences.en: The firemen, the air raid wardens, the ambulance drivers.
sentences.zh: 消防员、空袭监视员、救护车司机。

sentences.en: And there's the wail of the Banshee.
sentences.zh: 空袭警报声响起了。

sentences.en: The nightly siege of London has begun.
sentences.zh: 伦敦的夜间围城战开始了。

sentences.en: The city is dressed for battle.
sentences.zh: 这座城市已披上战袍。

sentences.en: The sun set over wartime London, blanketing the entire city in darkness.
sentences.zh: 太阳在战时的伦敦落下，将整座城市笼罩在黑暗之中。

sentences.en: The streetlights on the mostly bare roads were dimmed or turned off.
sentences.zh: 大部分空旷道路上的路灯都被调暗或熄灭了。

sentences.en: Slotted covers were fitted onto traffic lights and emergency vehicles to direct their bright glow to the ground.
sentences.zh: 交通灯和紧急车辆上都加装了开槽遮光罩，将强光导向地面。

sentences.en: Pedestrians navigated the shadowy streets with great difficulty.
sentences.zh: 行人在阴影笼罩的街道上艰难前行。

sentences.en: They were permitted to carry a small, six-inch flashlight, but it had to be cast downwards and could only be turned on sparingly.
sentences.zh: 他们被允许携带一支六英寸长的小手电筒，但光束必须向下，且只能偶尔开启。

sentences.en: This was the life of a Londoner since September 1939.
sentences.zh: 这就是自1939年9月以来伦敦人的生活。

sentences.en: The war had become the backdrop of everyday life.
sentences.zh: 战争已成为日常生活的背景。

sentences.en: Walls were plastered with propaganda posters warning of Nazi espionage.
sentences.zh: 墙上贴满了警告纳粹间谍活动的宣传海报。

sentences.en: Sandbags were piled high around lampposts and in doorways.
sentences.zh: 灯柱周围和门口堆满了高高的沙袋。

sentences.en: Barbed wire encircled government buildings, which were protected by anti-aircraft weaponry.
sentences.zh: 政府大楼周围环绕着铁丝网，并有防空武器保护。

sentences.en: Pontoon bridges spanned the River Thames, its embankment peppered with concrete guard posts.
sentences.zh: 泰晤士河上架起了浮桥，河堤上布满了混凝土岗哨。

sentences.en: Brick bomb shelters had been constructed throughout the city for civilians to swiftly hide in should the enemy breach the perimeter.
sentences.zh: 城内各处都修建了砖砌防空洞，以便敌军突破防线时平民能迅速躲避。

sentences.en: Most people chose to spend evenings at home, hidden behind windows covered with cardboard, thick curtains, or black painted glass.
sentences.zh: 大多数人选择晚上待在家里，躲在被纸板、厚窗帘或涂黑玻璃遮挡的窗户后面。

sentences.en: Strict penalties were dulled out to anyone who led even the slightest sliver of light escape.
sentences.zh: 任何让哪怕一丝光亮泄露出去的人都会受到严厉惩罚。

sentences.en: To hinder enemy aircraft from bombing attacks, the city had enforced nightly blackouts, the least popular of all anti-bombardment implementations.
sentences.zh: 为了阻止敌机轰炸，全市实施了夜间灯火管制，这是所有防空措施中最不受欢迎的一项。

sentences.en: It left the city's nightlife in quiet stasis, disrupting many lives and lowering morale.
sentences.zh: 它使城市的夜生活陷入了沉寂，扰乱了许多人的生活，并降低了士气。

sentences.en: Looting, theft, burglaries, robberies, and gang-related crime increased under the cover of darkness.
sentences.zh: 在黑暗的掩护下，抢劫、盗窃、入室行窃和帮派犯罪有所增加。

sentences.en: As did rape and murder.
sentences.zh: 强奸和谋杀案也是如此。

sentences.en: On the night of Sunday, February 8, 1942, 41-year-old Evelyn Hamilton arrived at a boarding house in London's West End.
sentences.zh: 1942年2月8日，星期日晚上，41岁的伊芙琳·汉密尔顿抵达了伦敦西区的一家寄宿公寓。

sentences.en: She would only be staying for one night as she made her way further north to the port town of Grimsby.
sentences.zh: 她只打算住一晚，然后继续向北前往格里姆斯比港。

sentences.en: After unpacking and settling into her room, Evelyn asked the boarding house owner where she could get a late meal.
sentences.zh: 整理好行李并在房间安顿下来后，伊芙琳询问房东哪里可以吃顿宵夜。

sentences.en: She was directed to a restaurant approximately half a mile away on Oxford Street.
sentences.zh: 房东指引她去大约半英里外牛津街上的一家餐馆。

sentences.en: It was nearing midnight when Evelyn rugged up and made her way through the cold, dark streets to the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 临近午夜时，伊芙琳裹紧衣服，穿过寒冷黑暗的街道前往餐馆。

sentences.en: One of the few places that maintained some element of the boisterous pre-war festivities was Lion's Corner House.
sentences.zh: 狮子角屋餐厅是少数几个仍保留着战前喧闹节日气氛的地方之一。

sentences.en: The large, ornate eatery was a popular haunt for military men and volunteers tasked with safeguarding London at night.
sentences.zh: 这家装饰华丽的大型餐馆是军人和负责夜间保卫伦敦的志愿者们常去的地方。

sentences.en: While it appeared dark and quiet from the outside, inside, the restaurant was abuzz with live music and patrons drinking to forget about the everyday stress of war.
sentences.zh: 虽然从外面看显得昏暗安静，但餐馆内部却热闹非凡，现场音乐响起，客人们饮酒作乐，试图忘却战争带来的日常压力。

sentences.en: Evelyn was led to a table and ordered a celebratory glass of wine.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳被带到一张桌子旁，点了一杯庆祝用的葡萄酒。

sentences.en: Not only was it her birthday, she was about to start a new job as a pharmacy manager and was looking forward to new beginnings.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是她的生日，她还即将开始一份药房经理的新工作，对未来充满期待。

sentences.en: By the time Evelyn finished her meal, it was early Monday morning and the sun had yet to rise.
sentences.zh: 当伊芙琳吃完饭时，已经是周一凌晨，太阳尚未升起。

sentences.en: The transition from the bright restaurant interior to the unlit, foggy streets was disorientating enough, but Evelyn had to walk extra cautiously in her high heels.
sentences.zh: 从明亮的餐馆内部走到漆黑多雾的街道上，这种反差足以让人迷失方向，而伊芙琳还得穿着高跟鞋格外小心地行走。

sentences.en: She made her way along Montague Place, passing a cluster of unoccupied above-ground bomb shelters.
sentences.zh: 她沿着蒙塔古广场走去，经过了一排空置的地面防空洞。

sentences.en: As she walked by the central shelter, she was suddenly grabbed from behind and dragged inside.
sentences.zh: 当她走过中间的防空洞时，突然被人从身后抓住并拖了进去。

sentences.en: Hours later, at 8.40am, two men were walking along Montague Place when a weak beam of light caught their attention.
sentences.zh: 几小时后，即上午8点40分，两名男子走在蒙塔古广场时，一道微弱的光束引起了他们的注意。

sentences.en: It was emanating from a small torch that lay in the doorway of a nearby bomb shelter.
sentences.zh: 光线来自附近一个防空洞门口的一支小手电筒。

sentences.en: The men went to investigate.
sentences.zh: 两人上前查看。

sentences.en: Just inside the door lay the lifeless body of Evelyn Hamilton, her torn blouse exposing one of her breasts.
sentences.zh: 门内躺着伊芙琳·汉密尔顿冰冷的尸体，她撕裂的衬衫露出了其中一只乳房。

sentences.en: Her skirt had also been lifted up, with her underwear pulled below her knees.
sentences.zh: 她的裙子也被掀起，内衣被拉到了膝盖以下。

sentences.en: The men rushed out to alert a police officer and the cramped shelter was soon teeming with detectives.
sentences.zh: 两人冲出去报警，狭窄的防空洞很快挤满了侦探。

sentences.en: Scuff marks on Evelyn's shoes and broken pieces of mortar indicated she had fought to free herself during the skirmish.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳鞋上的擦痕和破碎的砂浆表明她在挣扎中曾试图反抗。

sentences.en: But she had no defensive wounds, meaning her killer struck fast and unexpectedly before she could gather her bearings and fight back.
sentences.zh: 但她身上没有防御性伤口，这意味着凶手下手极快且出其不意，让她还没来得及反应就遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: Bruising and fingernail abrasions along her neck showed that she had been manually strangled, which prevented her from screaming for help and resulted in her death.
sentences.zh: 颈部的淤青和指甲抓痕显示她曾被人徒手勒死，这让她无法呼救并最终导致死亡。

sentences.en: The absence of foreign fingerprints meant her killer had worn gloves.
sentences.zh: 现场没有发现外人的指纹，说明凶手戴了手套。

sentences.en: Evelyn's wristwatch was frozen in the one o'clock position, likely broken during the assault.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳的手表停在一点钟位置，很可能是在袭击中损坏的。

sentences.en: This allowed detectives to narrow down the exact time she was set upon.
sentences.zh: 这让侦探们得以缩小她遇袭的具体时间。

sentences.en: A light layer of snow had fallen across the city that morning, but there was no chance of retrieving the perpetrator's footprints from outside the shelter.
sentences.zh: 那天早上城市里下了一层薄雪，但已无法从防空洞外提取到凶手的脚印。

sentences.en: The movements of onlookers, detectives and other crime scene examiners had turned the snow into slush.
sentences.zh: 围观者、侦探和其他犯罪现场调查人员的走动已将雪踩成了泥浆。

sentences.en: The blackout had worked in the killer's favour by providing them with a cover of darkness and isolation.
sentences.zh: 灯火管制为凶手提供了黑暗和孤立的掩护，这对他非常有利。

sentences.en: Because of this, no locals had seen or heard anything suspicious.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，当地居民没有看到或听到任何可疑情况。

sentences.en: Yet, the scene showed the killer was rushed and likely didn't finish what he had intended.
sentences.zh: 然而，现场显示凶手行色匆匆，很可能没能完成他预想的暴行。

sentences.en: While there was no physical evidence that Evelyn had been sexually assaulted, the state of her clothing indicated her assailant had intended to do so, but fled mid-attack.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有物证表明伊芙琳遭到了性侵，但她衣衫不整的状态表明袭击者意图如此，却在袭击中途逃离了。

sentences.en: Perhaps he feared he would be caught in the act.
sentences.zh: 也许他担心作案时被发现。

sentences.en: Evelyn's handbag was found discarded on the pavement not far from the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳的手提包被发现丢弃在离案发现场不远的人行道上。

sentences.en: It still contained Evelyn's identity card and a ration book, but her wallet was empty of cash.
sentences.zh: 包里还有伊芙琳的身份证和配给手册，但钱包里的现金不见了。

sentences.en: Evelyn's sister told detectives that Evelyn was known to carry large amounts of money as she didn't trust banks.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳的姐姐告诉侦探，伊芙琳习惯随身携带大量现金，因为她不信任银行。

sentences.en: She believed Evelyn had 80 pounds stolen from her bag, the equivalent of 4,000 pounds today.
sentences.zh: 她认为伊芙琳包里被偷走了80英镑，相当于今天的4000英镑。

sentences.en: It seemed highly unlikely that Evelyn knew her killer given she was only briefly passing through London.
sentences.zh: 鉴于伊芙琳只是短暂停留伦敦，她认识凶手的可能性极低。

sentences.en: She had never been in a relationship and there wasn't anyone within her social circle that could be immediately highlighted as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 她从未谈过恋爱，社交圈里也没有人能立即被列为嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Men who Evelyn had encountered during her short stay in London were questioned, including the owner of the West End Boarding House and other patrons at the restaurant she visited.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳在伦敦短暂停留期间接触过的男性都受到了盘问，包括西区寄宿公寓的房东以及她去过的餐馆里的其他顾客。

sentences.en: One by one they were ruled out, leaving homicide detectives with no feasible leads.
sentences.zh: 他们被一一排除，凶杀案侦探们陷入了毫无头绪的境地。

sentences.en: Later that Monday night, 35-year-old Evelyn Oatley sipped a scotch in the King's Arm pub, just under two miles from where Evelyn Hamilton had been killed less than 24 hours prior.
sentences.zh: 周一晚些时候，35岁的伊芙琳·奥特利在国王之臂酒吧喝着苏格兰威士忌，距离伊芙琳·汉密尔顿遇害不到24小时，地点相距不到两英里。

sentences.en: Evelyn Oatley had called London home for the past six years, making the big move from a poultry farm in Blackpool in the hopes of becoming a stage actress.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳·奥特利已经在伦敦居住了六年，她从布莱克浦的一个养鸡场搬到这里，梦想成为一名舞台演员。

sentences.en: The West End was renowned for its theatres, meaning it was the perfect place for Evelyn to settle down and begin her new career.
sentences.zh: 西区以剧院闻名，是伊芙琳安顿下来开启新职业生涯的理想之地。

sentences.en: The outbreak of the war changed everything.
sentences.zh: 战争的爆发改变了一切。

sentences.en: With Evelyn's theatre dream halted, she did whatever she could to get by.
sentences.zh: 随着伊芙琳的演艺梦想破灭，她只能靠做各种工作维持生计。

sentences.en: It was a hard and lonely time, as the neon theatre lights that drew her to the West End were permanently shut off.
sentences.zh: 那是一段艰难而孤独的时光，曾经吸引她来到西区的霓虹灯剧院招牌已永久熄灭。

sentences.en: When the King's Arms pub closed, Evelyn stepped outside into the crisp darkness and made her way to her bedsit apartment on Wardour Street.
sentences.zh: 当国王之臂酒吧关门时，伊芙琳走进清冷的黑暗中，前往她位于华多街的单间公寓。

sentences.en: She shared the building with two other tenants, an elderly man who lived on the floor above and a woman named Ivy Poole who lived across the hall.
sentences.zh: 她与另外两名租户共用这栋楼，楼上一位老人，以及住在走廊对面的艾薇·普尔。

sentences.en: Evelyn arrived home just before midnight.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳在午夜前回到家。

sentences.en: As she opened the front door and stepped into the hallway, she was suddenly bathed in light.
sentences.zh: 当她打开前门走进走廊时，突然被灯光照亮。

sentences.en: Ivy stood on the landing above, having quickly flicked on a light to help Evelyn find her way up the stairwell.
sentences.zh: 艾薇站在楼上的平台上，她迅速打开灯，想帮伊芙琳照亮上楼的路。

sentences.en: Evelyn expressed her thanks and made her way up.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳表示感谢并走了上去。

sentences.en: She wasn't alone.
sentences.zh: 她并不是一个人。

sentences.en: She was joined by a man in his mid-twenties and the pair disappeared into her apartment together.
sentences.zh: 她身边跟着一名二十五岁左右的男子，两人一起走进了她的公寓。

sentences.en: Ivy was aware that Evelyn occasionally engaged in sex work to make ends meet, but this was the first time she had seen her with a client so young.
sentences.zh: 艾薇知道伊芙琳偶尔会从事性工作来维持生计，但这是她第一次见到她带这么年轻的客人回来。

sentences.en: Ivy returned to her own apartment and could hear Evelyn's wireless radio playing as she chatted quietly with her male companion.
sentences.zh: 艾薇回到自己的公寓，能听到伊芙琳的无线电收音机里播放着音乐，她正与男伴低声交谈。

sentences.en: At around 12.30, just as Ivy was beginning to doze off, she was jolted awake by blaring jazz music.
sentences.zh: 大约12点30分，就在艾薇快要睡着时，震耳欲聋的爵士乐把她惊醒了。

sentences.en: The wireless in Evelyn's apartment had been turned up as loudly as it would go.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳公寓里的收音机音量被调到了最大。

sentences.en: This was unlike Evelyn, who was considerate of her neighbours and never played music at such a volume.
sentences.zh: 这不像伊芙琳的作风，她一向体谅邻居，从不把音乐开得这么大声。

sentences.en: Ivy considered knocking on Evelyn's door to ask her to turn it down, but she didn't want to interrupt.
sentences.zh: 艾薇想去敲门让她调小音量，但又不想打扰他们。

sentences.en: Instead, she rolled over and tried her hardest to get to sleep.
sentences.zh: 于是，她翻了个身，努力让自己入睡。

sentences.en: The music continued on for some time before it suddenly stopped and everything fell silent.
sentences.zh: 音乐持续了一段时间，然后突然停止，一切归于寂静。

sentences.en: The next morning of Tuesday February 10, Ivy was reading the paper when there was a knock at her door.
sentences.zh: 第二天，2月10日星期二，艾薇正在看报纸时，有人敲她的门。

sentences.en: She was greeted by two workmen who were collecting money from the personal electricity meters installed in each apartment.
sentences.zh: 门口站着两名工人，他们正在收取每间公寓安装的个人电表的费用。

sentences.en: At the time, light and heat were supplied to homes for an hourly fee via coin-operated machines.
sentences.zh: 当时，家庭照明和取暖是通过投币式机器按小时收费的。

sentences.en: The two men asked if there was anyone else living in the building.
sentences.zh: 两人询问楼里是否还有其他人居住。

sentences.en: Ivy told them about Evelyn Oatley, whom she assumed was sleeping in after her late night.
sentences.zh: 艾薇告诉他们伊芙琳·奥特利的事，以为她是因为昨晚太晚而睡懒觉。

sentences.en: Ivy accompanied the workmen across the hall and knocked on Evelyn's door.
sentences.zh: 艾薇陪同工人们穿过走廊，敲了伊芙琳的门。

sentences.en: To her surprise, it swung open on its hinges.
sentences.zh: 令她惊讶的是，门应声而开。

sentences.en: Evelyn's apartment was cold, dark and quiet, with the electricity meter having run out.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳的公寓里寒冷、黑暗且安静，电表已经没钱了。

sentences.en: The blackout curtains positioned over the windows made it difficult to see anything inside, so one of the workmen shone a torch into the room.
sentences.zh: 窗户上的遮光窗帘让人看不清里面的情况，于是其中一名工人用手电筒照进房间。

sentences.en: It illuminated Evelyn's body lying diagonally across her bed.
sentences.zh: 光束照亮了斜躺在床上的伊芙琳的尸体。

sentences.en: Her head extended over the side, exposing a deep gash across her neck that pulled blood on the floor below.
sentences.zh: 她的头垂在床边，脖子上有一道深深的伤口，鲜血滴落在地板上。

sentences.en: Ivy, still clad in her pyjamas, rushed down the stairwell with the workmen in tow.
sentences.zh: 穿着睡衣的艾薇带着工人们冲下楼梯。

sentences.en: They burst out onto the street where they spotted a policeman and called for his attention.
sentences.zh: 他们冲到街上，看到一名警察，便大声呼救。

sentences.en: We just found a dead woman, one of the workmen cried out breathlessly.
sentences.zh: “我们刚发现了一名死去的女人，”其中一名工人气喘吁吁地喊道。

sentences.en: It was estimated that Evelyn Oatley was killed three to four hours prior.
sentences.zh: 据估计，伊芙琳·奥特利是在三到四小时前遇害的。

sentences.en: A blood-stained razor blade and a pair of hair-curling tongs also caked in blood were resting on the blanket beside Evelyn's head.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳头边的毯子上放着一把沾满血迹的剃须刀片和一把同样沾满血迹的卷发钳。

sentences.en: Positioned between her legs was a metal can opener with a sharp tip that was used to pierce tin cans.
sentences.zh: 在她双腿之间放着一个金属开罐器，尖端锋利，通常用来刺开罐头。

sentences.en: In this case, it had been used to carry out a violent sexual assault and mutilation.
sentences.zh: 在本案中，它被用来实施了暴力的性侵犯和肢解。

sentences.en: A small flashlight had also been inserted inside Evelyn where it still remained.
sentences.zh: 一支小手电筒也被插入了伊芙琳体内，至今仍留在里面。

sentences.en: Although Evelyn's throat had been cut, bruising and abrasions around the gaping wound and the hemorrhaging of her eyes revealed that she had first been manually strangled.
sentences.zh: 虽然伊芙琳的喉咙被割开，但伤口周围的淤青、擦伤以及眼睛的充血表明她先是被徒手勒死。

sentences.en: Once unconscious, Evelyn's throat was fatally slit with the razor blade.
sentences.zh: 在失去知觉后，伊芙琳的喉咙才被剃须刀片残忍割开。

sentences.en: The majority of the sexual violence occurred when she was on the brink of death, with the flashlight having been inserted into her body post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 大部分性暴力发生在伊芙琳濒死之际，而手电筒是在她死后插入体内的。

sentences.en: Evelyn's handbag and wallet were still in her apartment, but their contents were scattered and both were empty of cash.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳的手提包和钱包仍在公寓里，但里面的东西散落一地，现金全无。

sentences.en: Only Ivy Poole could provide a description of the young man who had come home with her murdered neighbour.
sentences.zh: 只有艾薇·普尔能描述那个与她遇害邻居一起回家的年轻男子。

sentences.en: He hadn't said a word as he followed Evelyn into her apartment, but Ivy recalled his short, wavy hair that was combed to one side.
sentences.zh: 他跟着伊芙琳进屋时一言不发，但艾薇记得他留着短波浪发，梳向一边。

sentences.en: His pointed jaw was clean-shaven except for a moustache that framed the top of his thin lips.
sentences.zh: 他下巴尖削，刮得很干净，只有嘴唇上方留着一撇胡子。

sentences.en: Standing about 5 feet 8 inches tall, he had been wearing a light blue overcoat buttoned up to the collar.
sentences.zh: 他身高约5英尺8英寸，穿着一件扣到领口的浅蓝色大衣。

sentences.en: Two women had now been violently murdered in central London within a 24-hour period.
sentences.zh: 在24小时内，伦敦市中心已有两名女性惨遭杀害。

sentences.en: Evelyn Hamilton's case was rare, involving an opportunistic killer snatching a random woman off London's darkened streets.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳·汉密尔顿的案件很罕见，涉及一名机会主义杀手在伦敦黑暗的街道上随机抓走一名女性。

sentences.en: In contrast, the murder of a sex worker wasn't nearly as uncommon.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，性工作者的谋杀案并不罕见。

sentences.en: Evelyn Oatley's murder was also far more bloody and violent, carried out by a sadistic killer driven by sexual degradation.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳·奥特利的谋杀案也更加血腥暴力，是由一名受性变态驱动的杀手所为。

sentences.en: While the differences between the two slayings implied two distinct perpetrators, police weren't so sure.
sentences.zh: 虽然两起案件的差异暗示可能是两名不同的凶手，但警方并不确定。

sentences.en: After his seemingly unfinished public attack on Evelyn Hamilton, the killer might have learnt from his mistakes and struck behind closed doors,
sentences.zh: 在对伊芙琳·汉密尔顿那次看似未遂的公开袭击后，凶手可能吸取了教训，转而在封闭的室内作案，

sentences.en: where there'd be less risk or distraction.
sentences.zh: 那里风险更小，也更少干扰。

sentences.en: Then there was the bruising on each of the victims' necks.
sentences.zh: 此外，两名受害者颈部都有淤青。

sentences.en: It showed that they had both been strangled by a left-handed individual.
sentences.zh: 这表明她们都是被一名左撇子勒死的。

sentences.en: Following the murder of Evelyn Oatley, London's sex workers were on heightened alert.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳·奥特利遇害后，伦敦的性工作者们处于高度戒备状态。

sentences.en: The West End area in which the killer struck was referred to in the papers as the Mile of Terror.
sentences.zh: 凶手作案的西区在报纸上被称为“恐怖之英里”。

sentences.en: While some women were extra cautious about who they accepted as clientele, others couldn't afford to be picky.
sentences.zh: 虽然有些女性对挑选客户格外谨慎，但其他人却无法挑剔。

sentences.en: Some refused to be inhibited by fear.
sentences.zh: 有些人拒绝被恐惧所束缚。

sentences.en: Although frowned upon by society, the act of paying for sex wasn't illegal and sex workers were busier than ever.
sentences.zh: 尽管社会对此不齿，但花钱买春并不违法，性工作者们比以往任何时候都忙碌。

sentences.en: Wartime bred a sense of recklessness, as no one knew what the future held, driving people to indulge.
sentences.zh: 战争滋生了一种鲁莽感，因为没人知道未来会怎样，这驱使人们放纵自己。

sentences.en: Female police officers posed undercover as sex workers within the Mile of Terror, hoping to flush the killer out.
sentences.zh: 女警官们乔装成性工作者在“恐怖之英里”巡逻，希望能引出凶手。

sentences.en: But he didn't take the bait.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有上钩。

sentences.en: Two nights after the Hamilton and Oatley murders,
sentences.zh: 在汉密尔顿和奥特利遇害后的两个晚上，

sentences.en: 28-year-old sex worker Patricia Borg walked the drizzly streets of London's Paddington district on the lookout for potential clients.
sentences.zh: 28岁的性工作者帕特里夏·博格走在伦敦帕丁顿区细雨蒙蒙的街道上，寻找潜在客户。

sentences.en: It was nearing 10pm and business was quiet.
sentences.zh: 当时已近晚上10点，生意很冷清。

sentences.en: Wanting a break from the cold, Patricia stopped by an empty storefront and lit a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 为了躲避寒冷，帕特里夏停在一个空店面旁，点了一支烟。

sentences.en: Just as she was considering calling at a night, a man approached and asked Patricia,
sentences.zh: 就在她考虑收工时，一名男子走过来问帕特里夏，

sentences.en: Given the city-wide blackout, Patricia struggled to see the man through the dark, but he spoke with a refined English accent that indicated he was highly educated.
sentences.zh: 由于全市灯火管制，帕特里夏在黑暗中很难看清那名男子，但他说话带着一种优雅的英式口音，显示他受过高等教育。

sentences.en: Two pounds was a substantial amount for the time, but despite being desperate for the money, Patricia declined.
sentences.zh: 两英镑在当时是一笔不小的数目，但尽管帕特里夏急需用钱，她还是拒绝了。

sentences.en: Something about the man's mannerisms gave her the creeps and the brazen way he propositioned Patricia made her wary.
sentences.zh: 这个男人举手投足间透着一股怪异，让他显得有些阴森，而他向帕特里夏搭讪时那种厚颜无耻的态度也让她心生警惕。

sentences.en: The man took a deep inhale of a cigarette and backed away.
sentences.zh: 男人深深地吸了一口烟，然后向后退去。

sentences.en: He asked if Patricia knew of any woman who would have him for two pounds.
sentences.zh: 他问帕特里夏认不认识哪个女人愿意为了两英镑跟他走。

sentences.en: She said no.
sentences.zh: 她说不认识。

sentences.en: The man then walked down the road and disappeared into the shadows.
sentences.zh: 男人随后沿着马路走去，消失在阴影中。

sentences.en: Everyone should carry his gas mask just as the civil defence services do.
sentences.zh: 每个人都应该像民防部门的人员一样，随身携带防毒面具。

sentences.en: They're under strict orders and always carry them.
sentences.zh: 他们有严格的规定，必须时刻携带。

sentences.en: How many of you carry your gas masks?
sentences.zh: 你们中有多少人随身带着防毒面具？

sentences.en: Yet civilians are just as much in danger of a gas attack as the services, and they should take the same precautions.
sentences.zh: 然而，平民和这些服务人员一样，同样面临着毒气袭击的危险，他们也应该采取同样的预防措施。

sentences.en: You should have your gas mask with you always.
sentences.zh: 你应该时刻随身携带防毒面具。

sentences.en: If you're out in the street when the warning rattle goes, put on your gas mask and get undercover.
sentences.zh: 如果你在街上听到警报声，请戴上防毒面具并寻找掩体。

sentences.en: Wherever you go, have your gas mask with you always.
sentences.zh: 无论你去哪里，都要时刻带着你的防毒面具。

sentences.en: Later in the evening, after Patricia Borg turned down her prospective client,
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚晚些时候，在帕特里夏·博格拒绝了她的潜在客户之后，

sentences.en: 25-year-old Catherine Mulcahy was standing on the corner of Regent Street in the West End.
sentences.zh: 25岁的凯瑟琳·马尔卡希正站在西区摄政街的拐角处。

sentences.en: A young man approached, his face barely visible in the faint glow of the cigarette he inhaled.
sentences.zh: 一名年轻男子走近，他吸着烟，微弱的火光映照下，他的脸几乎看不清。

sentences.en: With each smoky breath he stepped closer.
sentences.zh: 随着每一次吞云吐雾，他都走得更近了。

sentences.en: Eyeing Catherine from head to toe, he asked,
sentences.zh: 他从头到脚打量着凯瑟琳，问道：

sentences.en: Will you go with me?
sentences.zh: 你愿意跟我走吗？

sentences.en: Catherine was apprehensive.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳感到不安。

sentences.en: Although the man smiled broadly and appeared friendly, his eyes were emotionless, like empty pits.
sentences.zh: 尽管男人笑得很灿烂，看起来很友好，但他的眼神毫无感情，就像空洞的深渊。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, she accepted his offer and the pair climbed into a taxi bound for Catherine's apartment near Hyde Park.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她还是接受了他的提议，两人坐上一辆出租车，前往凯瑟琳在海德公园附近的公寓。

sentences.en: By the time they arrived, Catherine was having second thoughts, but she had already taken the man's money and feared his reaction should she deny her services now.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达时，凯瑟琳开始后悔了，但她已经收了男人的钱，担心如果现在拒绝服务会招致他的报复。

sentences.en: Neither Catherine nor the man had changed for the electricity meter, so Catherine burned a piece of paper in a saucepan to provide them with a few minutes of light.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳和男人都没有给电表投币，所以凯瑟琳在平底锅里烧了一张纸，为他们提供了几分钟的光亮。

sentences.en: They removed their clothes and climbed into bed.
sentences.zh: 他们脱掉衣服上了床。

sentences.en: For a brief moment, everything seemed to be going as planned.
sentences.zh: 有那么一瞬间，一切似乎都按计划进行。

sentences.en: Then the man dug his knees hard into Catherine's stomach, winding her.
sentences.zh: 接着，男人用膝盖狠狠地顶住凯瑟琳的肚子，让她喘不过气来。

sentences.en: He moved so quickly that Catherine had little time to react.
sentences.zh: 他的动作太快，凯瑟琳几乎来不及反应。

sentences.en: Before she knew it, the man had wrapped his hands around her throat.
sentences.zh: 还没等她回过神来，男人的双手已经扼住了她的喉咙。

sentences.en: There was no doubt in Catherine's mind that she was about to be killed.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳心里很清楚，她快要没命了。

sentences.en: She fought back as best she could, thrashing, clawing and grabbing at her attacker.
sentences.zh: 她拼命反抗，挣扎、抓挠、撕扯着袭击者。

sentences.en: It was no use, he wouldn't let up.
sentences.zh: 没用，他根本不松手。

sentences.en: Realising she was still wearing her boots, Catherine sourced what little energy she had left and kicked the man hard in the stomach.
sentences.zh: 意识到自己还穿着靴子，凯瑟琳使出最后一点力气，狠狠地踢向男人的肚子。

sentences.en: He rolled off the bed, cradling his gut, giving Catherine the opportunity to run out the front door.
sentences.zh: 他从床上滚了下来，捂着肚子，给了凯瑟琳逃出前门的机会。

sentences.en: Kitty McQuillen lived across the hall from Catherine Mulcahy.
sentences.zh: 基蒂·麦奎伦住在凯瑟琳·马尔卡希的对面。

sentences.en: It was 11pm when she heard the commotion outside her door and was startled by Catherine's voice screaming,
sentences.zh: 晚上11点，她听到门外传来骚动，被凯瑟琳尖叫的声音吓了一跳：

sentences.en: Murder!
sentences.zh: 杀人啦！

sentences.en: Police!
sentences.zh: 警察！

sentences.en: Kitty opened her front door just as Catherine rushed inside, naked except for a pair of boots.
sentences.zh: 基蒂打开前门，凯瑟琳赤身裸体地冲了进来，只穿着一双靴子。

sentences.en: Kitty caught sight of the silhouette of a naked man through the doorway into Catherine's dark apartment, before slamming her own door shut and arming herself with a heavy vase.
sentences.zh: 基蒂透过门缝看到凯瑟琳昏暗的公寓里有一个裸男的剪影，她随即猛地关上自己的门，并拿了一个沉重的花瓶防身。

sentences.en: The man called out in an unusually calm voice.
sentences.zh: 男人用一种异常冷静的声音喊道。

sentences.en: Give me a light.
sentences.zh: 给我点火。

sentences.en: Miss, give me a match.
sentences.zh: 小姐，给我根火柴。

sentences.en: Kitty opened the door and threw the man a box of matches.
sentences.zh: 基蒂打开门，扔给男人一盒火柴。

sentences.en: He collected them off the floor, then struck one to observe his surroundings.
sentences.zh: 他从地上捡起火柴，划亮一根观察周围的环境。

sentences.en: Kitty could make out his pointed chin, but very little else.
sentences.zh: 基蒂能看出他尖尖的下巴，但其他特征却看不太清。

sentences.en: Have you seen my boots?
sentences.zh: 你看见我的靴子了吗？

sentences.en: He then asked.
sentences.zh: 他随后问道。

sentences.en: Kitty and Catherine watched nervously as the man stumbled about in the dark, collecting his clothes.
sentences.zh: 基蒂和凯瑟琳紧张地看着男人在黑暗中跌跌撞撞地捡起他的衣服。

sentences.en: When his match burnt out, he lit another.
sentences.zh: 当火柴烧完时，他又点燃了另一根。

sentences.en: Once he had managed to dress himself, he moved towards Kitty's apartment door.
sentences.zh: 穿好衣服后，他朝基蒂的公寓门走去。

sentences.en: She raised her vase defensively while Catherine gripped her tightly from behind.
sentences.zh: 她举起花瓶防卫，而凯瑟琳在身后紧紧抓着她。

sentences.en: Catherine was well aware of who she had crossed paths with.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳很清楚她遇到了什么人。

sentences.en: The man she had brought home had been the topic of conversation amongst those who occupied London's streets at night.
sentences.zh: 她带回家的这个男人，正是伦敦夜间街头巷尾议论纷纷的话题人物。

sentences.en: His horrific acts had reignited memories of an infamous unidentified killer that prowled the city 50 years prior.
sentences.zh: 他那令人毛骨悚然的行为，重新唤起了人们对50年前在城中游荡的一名臭名昭著的连环杀手的记忆。

sentences.en: Jack the Ripper slashed and mutilated sex workers in rage-fuelled attacks in London's East End between 1888 and 1891.
sentences.zh: 开膛手杰克曾在1888年至1891年间，在伦敦东区对性工作者进行了愤怒的砍杀和肢解。

sentences.en: While some theorised that he might still be alive and was continuing his spree, others were convinced the current killer was merely a copycat.
sentences.zh: 虽然有人推测他可能还活着并继续作案，但另一些人则坚信现在的杀手只是个模仿者。

sentences.en: They referred to him as the Blackout Ripper.
sentences.zh: 他们称他为“灯火管制下的开膛手”。

sentences.en: You're a murderer, Catherine Mulcahy yelled as the Blackout Ripper reproached.
sentences.zh: “你是杀人犯！”当“灯火管制下的开膛手”靠近时，凯瑟琳·马尔卡希尖叫道。

sentences.en: Without saying a word, he reached into his pockets and pulled out.
sentences.zh: 他一言不发，伸手进兜里掏出了东西。

sentences.en: A wad of cash.
sentences.zh: 一叠现金。

sentences.en: He counted out eight pounds in one-pound notes and threw them towards Catherine, saying,
sentences.zh: 他数出八张一英镑的钞票扔向凯瑟琳，说道：

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I think I had too much to drink.
sentences.zh: 对不起，我想我喝多了。

sentences.en: He then walked down the hallway, clambered down the stairs and headed out into the dark street.
sentences.zh: 随后他走下走廊，爬下楼梯，走进了黑暗的街道。

sentences.en: It was then that the Blackout Ripper crossed paths with Doris Duannet.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，“灯火管制下的开膛手”遇到了多丽丝·杜安内特。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持Casefile继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: Several years earlier, Henry Duannet had been aimlessly shopping on Oxford Street when he spotted a woman named Doris waiting at a bus stop.
sentences.zh: 几年前，亨利·杜安内特在牛津街漫无目的地购物时，发现一个叫多丽丝的女人正在公交车站等车。

sentences.en: He had noticed her in the West End before, but never felt it was appropriate to introduce himself.
sentences.zh: 他之前在西区见过她，但总觉得贸然上前搭讪不太合适。

sentences.en: This was his chance.
sentences.zh: 这次是他的机会。

sentences.en: What followed was a whirlwind romance that led to their marriage two months later.
sentences.zh: 随后是一段闪电般的恋情，两个月后他们便结婚了。

sentences.en: At the outset of the war, like many others, Henry and Doris found themselves in a financially precarious situation.
sentences.zh: 战争初期，像许多人一样，亨利和多丽丝陷入了经济拮据的境地。

sentences.en: Henry took a job as a staff manager of a hotel on Regent Street.
sentences.zh: 亨利在摄政街的一家酒店找了一份员工经理的工作。

sentences.en: At 7pm on Friday, February 13, he arrived home after spending nearly 24 hours at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 2月13日星期五晚上7点，他在酒店待了近24小时后回到了家。

sentences.en: To his surprise, the milk was still sitting on the doorstep from that morning's delivery.
sentences.zh: 令他惊讶的是，当天早上的牛奶还放在门阶上。

sentences.en: Henry opened the front door and called out to Doris.
sentences.zh: 亨利打开前门，呼唤多丽丝。

sentences.en: There was no response.
sentences.zh: 没有任何回应。

sentences.en: It was pitch black and he struggled to find the light switch.
sentences.zh: 屋里漆黑一片，他费了好大劲才找到电灯开关。

sentences.en: Once he did, his eyes were drawn to the remains of last night's meal still sitting on the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 打开灯后，他的目光被餐桌上昨晚剩下的饭菜吸引了。

sentences.en: Henry knew immediately that something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 亨利立刻意识到出事了。

sentences.en: Doris was extremely tidy and she wouldn't leave food out overnight.
sentences.zh: 多丽丝非常爱整洁，她绝不会把食物留在外面过夜。

sentences.en: Henry walked down the hallway towards their bedroom.
sentences.zh: 亨利沿着走廊走向卧室。

sentences.en: He could see that a light was on inside, but the door was shut and there was no response when he called out.
sentences.zh: 他看到里面亮着灯，但门关着，他叫喊时也没有回应。

sentences.en: When Henry tried to open the door, he realised it had been locked from the inside.
sentences.zh: 当亨利试图开门时，他发现门从里面锁上了。

sentences.en: Henry rummaged through the apartment looking for something he could use to jimmy open the door.
sentences.zh: 亨利在公寓里翻找可以用来撬门的工具。

sentences.en: Unable to find anything and with a growing sense of worry, Henry summoned the police.
sentences.zh: 什么也没找到，随着担忧加剧，亨利报了警。

sentences.en: An officer soon arrived and circled the exterior of the building looking for a window.
sentences.zh: 一名警察很快赶到，绕着建筑物外围寻找窗户。

sentences.en: The one leading into Henry and Doris' bedroom was covered by shutters and also locked from the inside.
sentences.zh: 通往亨利和多丽丝卧室的那扇窗户被百叶窗遮住，而且也从里面锁上了。

sentences.en: With no other option, the officer went inside and gave the couple's bedroom door a big, hard kick.
sentences.zh: 别无他法，警察走进屋里，对着这对夫妇的卧室门狠狠地踹了一脚。

sentences.en: The door dislodged from its hinges, granting the officer access to the room.
sentences.zh: 门被踢开了，警察得以进入房间。

sentences.en: His attention was immediately drawn to the bed.
sentences.zh: 他的注意力立刻被床吸引住了。

sentences.en: Although it appeared to be made, something was clearly underneath the blankets.
sentences.zh: 虽然床看起来铺好了，但毯子下面显然有什么东西。

sentences.en: The officer pulled the covers back, exposing Doris Duannet's body.
sentences.zh: 警察掀开被子，露出了多丽丝·杜安内特的尸体。

sentences.en: She was naked aside from a black nightgown that was left open.
sentences.zh: 她赤身裸体，只穿着一件敞开的黑色睡袍。

sentences.en: A silk stocking was wrapped tightly around the 32-year-old's neck.
sentences.zh: 一条丝袜紧紧地缠绕在这位32岁女性的脖子上。

sentences.en: Flesh had been carved out from under her left breast, multiple deep incisions had been made across her body and her genitals had been viciously mutilated.
sentences.zh: 她左乳下方的肉被挖走，身上有多处深切伤，生殖器也遭到了残忍的毁坏。

sentences.en: The officer exited the bedroom and told Henry,
sentences.zh: 警察走出卧室，告诉亨利：

sentences.en: I must advise you not to go in that room.
sentences.zh: 我建议你最好不要进那个房间。

sentences.en: Detectives who were still in the midst of investigating the murders of Evelyn Hamilton and Evelyn Oatley were summoned to the Duannet residence.
sentences.zh: 正在调查伊芙琳·汉密尔顿和伊芙琳·奥特利谋杀案的侦探们被传唤到了杜安内特家。

sentences.en: The blackout ripper had struck again.
sentences.zh: “灯火管制下的开膛手”再次作案了。

sentences.en: Henry was aware that Doris had been a sex worker before the two met and he conceded that she must have returned to the profession while he worked nights at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 亨利知道多丽丝在他们相遇前曾是性工作者，他也承认，在他晚上在酒店工作时，她一定又重操旧业了。

sentences.en: Still, her murder was a complete mystery to the devastated Henry, who later told reporters,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她的死对悲痛欲绝的亨利来说仍是一个谜，他后来告诉记者：

sentences.en: We lived for each other.
sentences.zh: 我们相依为命。

sentences.en: I wish myself dead because we were so fond of each other.
sentences.zh: 我真希望死的是我，因为我们彼此深爱着对方。

sentences.en: As detectives were documenting the crime scene, a police dispatcher pulled up on a motorbike outside.
sentences.zh: 当侦探们正在记录犯罪现场时，一名警察调度员骑着摩托车停在外面。

sentences.en: He walked into Doris' room with a letter in hand.
sentences.zh: 他手里拿着一封信走进多丽丝的房间。

sentences.en: Inside was a brief message to detectives.
sentences.zh: 里面是给侦探的一条简短信息。

sentences.en: Another body had been found.
sentences.zh: 又发现了一具尸体。

sentences.en: Earlier that day, fifteen-year-old Barbara Lowe took the train into London.
sentences.zh: 当天早些时候，15岁的芭芭拉·洛乘火车来到伦敦。

sentences.en: Barbara attended a boarding school in the resort town of South End-on-Sea,
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉在海滨小镇绍森德的一所寄宿学校上学，

sentences.en: but she ventured into London on the third Friday of every month to spend the weekend with her mother, Margaret.
sentences.zh: 但她每个月的第三个星期五都会去伦敦，和母亲玛格丽特共度周末。

sentences.en: The pair valued their catch-ups, which were often spent shopping, walking through the city's famed gardens, or seeing a film at the cinema.
sentences.zh: 母女俩很珍惜这种团聚，通常会一起购物、在城市著名的花园里散步，或者去看电影。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of February 13, 1942, Barbara arrived at her mother's apartment on Gosfield Street in West London.
sentences.zh: 1942年2月13日下午，芭芭拉抵达了母亲位于伦敦西区戈斯菲尔德街的公寓。

sentences.en: Bags in hand, Barbara excitedly knocked on the front door.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉提着包，兴奋地敲着前门。

sentences.en: There was no response.
sentences.zh: 没有任何回应。

sentences.en: After trying a few more times, Barbara walked down the road to visit her mother's friend.
sentences.zh: 又试了几次后，芭芭拉沿着路去拜访母亲的朋友。

sentences.en: The friend hadn't seen Margaret for a few days and didn't know where she could be.
sentences.zh: 那位朋友已经好几天没见到玛格丽特了，也不知道她会在哪里。

sentences.en: Barbara spent the next hour wandering the streets, thinking her mother must have gone out and that she might run into her.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉在街上徘徊了一个小时，以为母亲可能出去了，或许能碰上她。

sentences.en: Failing that, she returned to Gosfield Street and stood at her mother's door once again, banging loudly.
sentences.zh: 没能找到人，她回到戈斯菲尔德街，再次站在母亲门前大声敲门。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a neighbour's door swung open and he asked Barbara to step inside.
sentences.zh: 突然，邻居的门开了，他让芭芭拉进去。

sentences.en: Two police officers were waiting within, holding a package that had been left ignored on Margaret's doorstep for several days.
sentences.zh: 两名警察在里面等着，手里拿着一个包裹，那个包裹已经在玛格丽特的门阶上被忽略了好几天。

sentences.en: Margaret's neighbours had summoned the police after becoming worried.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特的邻居们担心起来，于是报了警。

sentences.en: They always kept an eye out for Margaret as they were aware she took on sex work to help pay for her daughter's tuition.
sentences.zh: 他们一直留意着玛格丽特，因为他们知道她为了支付女儿的学费而从事性工作。

sentences.en: As a result, Margaret had met some rough and violent men.
sentences.zh: 因此，玛格丽特遇到过一些粗暴且有暴力倾向的男人。

sentences.en: Two days earlier, in the early hours of February 11, a neighbour had heard a man wearing heavy boots come and go from Margaret's apartment, but they hadn't seen her since.
sentences.zh: 两天前，即2月11日凌晨，一位邻居听到一个穿着厚重靴子的男人进出玛格丽特的公寓，但从那以后就再没见过她。

sentences.en: The officers gained access to Margaret's apartment using a set of spare keys.
sentences.zh: 警察用一套备用钥匙进入了玛格丽特的公寓。

sentences.en: They moved through the darkened sitting room and into the cramped kitchen.
sentences.zh: 他们穿过昏暗的客厅，进入狭窄的厨房。

sentences.en: At the back was a bedroom with a locked door.
sentences.zh: 后面是一间锁着门的卧室。

sentences.en: Unable to locate a key, one of the officers kicked the door down.
sentences.zh: 找不到钥匙，其中一名警察把门踢开了。

sentences.en: The room inside was pitch black.
sentences.zh: 里面的房间漆黑一片。

sentences.en: The officer felt along the wall until he came upon a light switch and clicked it on.
sentences.zh: 警察沿着墙壁摸索，直到找到电灯开关并按了下去。

sentences.en: The burst of light exposed the bed on the right side of the room.
sentences.zh: 灯光亮起，照出了房间右侧的床。

sentences.en: Margaret Lowe lay in it, face up, with blankets pulled up to her chin.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·洛躺在床上，面朝上，毯子拉到了下巴处。

sentences.en: The officer pulled the covers back slightly, revealing a stocking tied tightly around her neck.
sentences.zh: 警察稍微掀开被子，露出缠在她脖子上的一条紧紧的丝袜。

sentences.en: Margaret Lowe bore the brunt of a vicious attack.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·洛遭受了极其残忍的攻击。

sentences.en: Several incisions had been made around her groin, with one five-inch long cut partially exposing her internal organs.
sentences.zh: 她的腹股沟周围有多处切口，其中一道五英寸长的伤口部分露出了内脏。

sentences.en: Lying near Margaret's legs was a large bread knife, two dinner knives, a paring knife and a metal fire poker, all of which were used in the attack.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特的腿边放着一把大面包刀、两把餐刀、一把削皮刀和一根金属火钳，这些都被用作了袭击工具。

sentences.en: A wax candle was found inside her, sourced from a glass candle holder on a nearby mantelpiece.
sentences.zh: 在她体内发现了一根蜡烛，是从附近壁炉架上的玻璃烛台上取下的。

sentences.en: The blackout ripper had now claimed four victims within a two-mile radius in just five days.
sentences.zh: “灯火管制下的开膛手”在短短五天内，在两英里范围内已经夺走了四条生命。

sentences.en: With each new attack surpassing the previous in severity, police knew that at this pace, he could strike again at any moment.
sentences.zh: 随着每一次新的袭击都比前一次更加严重，警方知道照此速度，他随时可能再次作案。

sentences.en: Later that evening, thirty-year-old Margaret Haywood, who was known to friends as Mary, sat alone in a crowded bar in Piccadilly Circus, a short walk from the West End.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上晚些时候，30岁的玛格丽特·海伍德（朋友们称她为玛丽）独自坐在皮卡迪利广场一家拥挤的酒吧里，离西区只有很短的路程。

sentences.en: She was waiting for a date.
sentences.zh: 她在等约会对象。

sentences.en: Minutes ticked by and Mary soon reached the conclusion that she had been stood up.
sentences.zh: 几分钟过去了，玛丽很快得出结论，她被放鸽子了。

sentences.en: As eight-thirty approached, a well-dressed and handsome young man walked over and took a seat behind her.
sentences.zh: 快到八点半时，一位衣着考究、英俊的年轻人走过来，坐在她身后。

sentences.en: In a refined British accent, he asked Mary if she would like a drink.
sentences.zh: 他用优雅的英式口音问玛丽是否想喝一杯。

sentences.en: Mary said she was waiting for someone, but this didn't dissuade the man.
sentences.zh: 玛丽说她在等人，但这并没有劝退那个男人。

sentences.en: He carried over two glasses of whiskey, handing one to Mary and downing his own with a single swig.
sentences.zh: 他端来两杯威士忌，递给玛丽一杯，自己则一饮而尽。

sentences.en: He then stared at Mary, enough to make her uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 然后他盯着玛丽看，看得她浑身不自在。

sentences.en: She didn't care for his overconfidence or charisma, but he persisted.
sentences.zh: 她并不在意他的过度自信或个人魅力，但他却纠缠不休。

sentences.en: Smiling, he asked to take her to dinner, adding, I have to be back at my unit by ten-thirty.
sentences.zh: 他微笑着请求带她去吃晚餐，并补充道：“我必须在十点半前赶回部队。”

sentences.en: Mary reluctantly agreed, a decision she regretted the longer she spent in the man's company.
sentences.zh: 玛丽勉强答应了，但随着与这个男人相处的时间越长，她就越后悔这个决定。

sentences.en: At one stage, he took a large wad of notes from his wallet and counted thirty pounds in front of her.
sentences.zh: 期间，他从钱包里掏出一大叠钞票，当着她的面数了三十英镑。

sentences.en: Understanding that he was trying to proposition her, Mary clarified that she wasn't a sex worker and went to leave.
sentences.zh: 玛丽明白他是在向她进行性暗示，于是明确表示自己不是性工作者，并准备离开。

sentences.en: The man persisted, calling her a nice girl and saying he fancied her.
sentences.zh: 那男人不依不饶，称赞她是个好女孩，还说他看上她了。

sentences.en: Mary remained firm, but ultimately agreed to give him her phone number.
sentences.zh: 玛丽态度坚决，但最终还是同意把电话号码留给他。

sentences.en: She wrote it down on a piece of paper that the man slipped into his coat pocket.
sentences.zh: 她把号码写在一张纸条上，男人顺手将其塞进了外套口袋。

sentences.en: Mary moved towards the door and the man followed her out, insisting they spend the night together.
sentences.zh: 玛丽走向门口，男人紧随其后，坚持要和她共度良宵。

sentences.en: While Mary found him handsome, she didn't even know his name.
sentences.zh: 虽然玛丽觉得他长得帅，但她甚至不知道他的名字。

sentences.en: She continued to refuse his advances until he seemingly accepted the rejection and said he'd escort her back to Piccadilly Circus.
sentences.zh: 她一直拒绝他的示好，直到他似乎接受了拒绝，并说会护送她回皮卡迪利广场。

sentences.en: They walked along in silence, when all of a sudden the man asked,
sentences.zh: 两人沉默地走着，突然，那男人问道：

sentences.en: Do you know that I knocked a girl out once?
sentences.zh: “你知道我曾经打晕过一个女孩吗？”

sentences.en: He said the girl's father had interfered in their relationship, which prompted him to lash out.
sentences.zh: 他说那个女孩的父亲干涉了他们的关系，这促使他大打出手。

sentences.en: It was a strange remark, but the man didn't elaborate.
sentences.zh: 这番话很奇怪，但男人没有多做解释。

sentences.en: He just continued onwards.
sentences.zh: 他只是继续往前走。

sentences.en: Struggling to see through the dark, Mary stumbled on some uneven pavement and took a small flashlight from her back.
sentences.zh: 由于在黑暗中视线受阻，玛丽在不平坦的人行道上绊了一下，从背后掏出一个小手电筒。

sentences.en: She had just turned it on when the man yanked it from her hands and switched it off, admonishing her for shining light in the street.
sentences.zh: 她刚打开手电，男人就从她手中夺过并关掉，还训斥她在街上乱照光。

sentences.en: It was then that Mary realised they were heading in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，玛丽意识到他们走错方向了。

sentences.en: Mary pointed this out, but the man brushed off her concerns.
sentences.zh: 玛丽指出了这一点，但男人对她的担忧不以为意。

sentences.en: He wanted to kiss her and asked Mary if she knew of any bomb shelters nearby.
sentences.zh: 他想亲吻她，并问玛丽是否知道附近有什么防空洞。

sentences.en: Unsure what to do, Mary walked with him a little longer until he eventually pulled her into an arched doorway.
sentences.zh: 玛丽不知所措，又和他走了一段路，直到他最终把她拉进了一个拱形门洞里。

sentences.en: He tried to undress her, but Mary fought back and attempted to run.
sentences.zh: 他试图脱掉她的衣服，但玛丽奋力反抗并试图逃跑。

sentences.en: The man grabbed her arm, pulled her back and blocked the entrance to the doorway so she couldn't escape.
sentences.zh: 男人抓住她的手臂，把她拉了回来，并堵住门洞入口，让她无法逃脱。

sentences.en: He then wrapped his hands around Mary's neck.
sentences.zh: 随后，他用双手掐住了玛丽的脖子。

sentences.en: Seemingly in a trance and with little emotion, he pressed his thumbs into Mary's windpipe as she struggled against him.
sentences.zh: 他似乎处于恍惚状态，几乎没有情绪波动，在玛丽挣扎时，他将大拇指深深按进她的气管。

sentences.en: The last thing she heard was the sound of his voice whispering over and over,
sentences.zh: 她最后听到的是他反复低语的声音：

sentences.en: You won't.
sentences.zh: “你不会的。”

sentences.en: You won't.
sentences.zh: “你不会的。”

sentences.en: You won't.
sentences.zh: “你不会的。”

sentences.en: You won't.
sentences.zh: “你不会的。”

sentences.en: It was approaching 10pm when 18-year-old John Shine walked through St James' Market towards Regent Street.
sentences.zh: 晚上快十点时，18岁的约翰·沙因穿过圣詹姆斯市场，朝摄政街走去。

sentences.en: He was passing a shallow side alley when he noticed a flashlight flickering on and off from under a doorway.
sentences.zh: 当他经过一条浅浅的侧巷时，注意到门洞下有一个手电筒在闪烁。

sentences.en: Driven by curiosity, John headed towards the light when he overheard the sound of a scuffle.
sentences.zh: 出于好奇，约翰朝光亮处走去，这时他听到了打斗声。

sentences.en: Following the noise, John stopped.
sentences.zh: 循着声音，约翰停下了脚步。

sentences.en: He could see a young woman lying in the doorway.
sentences.zh: 他看到一个年轻女子躺在门洞里。

sentences.en: A man stood over her, holding the flashlight that had caught John's attention earlier.
sentences.zh: 一个男人站在她上方，手里拿着刚才引起约翰注意的手电筒。

sentences.en: As soon as the man noticed John's presence, he dropped the flashlight and took off into the darkened surroundings.
sentences.zh: 男人一发现约翰，就扔掉手电筒，逃进了黑暗的四周。

sentences.en: John rushed towards the woman.
sentences.zh: 约翰冲向那个女子。

sentences.en: It was Mary Haywood.
sentences.zh: 她是玛丽·海伍德。

sentences.en: She lay unmoving, with her head against the door and legs pointing to the street.
sentences.zh: 她一动不动地躺着，头靠在门上，双腿伸向街道。

sentences.en: Her dress had been torn open and pulled up, exposing her thighs.
sentences.zh: 她的裙子被撕开并向上拉起，露出了大腿。

sentences.en: Her face was dirty and smeared with blood.
sentences.zh: 她的脸上满是污垢和血迹。

sentences.en: John knelt down beside Mary when all of a sudden she began to moan in pain.
sentences.zh: 约翰在玛丽身边跪下，这时她突然痛苦地呻吟起来。

sentences.en: He tried to help Mary to her feet, but her legs were weak and she was disorientated.
sentences.zh: 他试图扶玛丽站起来，但她双腿无力，神志不清。

sentences.en: A police officer who happened to be passing by noticed them and made his way over to help.
sentences.zh: 一名恰好路过的警察注意到了他们，便走过来帮忙。

sentences.en: Mary began to cry, what has he done?
sentences.zh: 玛丽哭着问：“他做了什么？”

sentences.en: She pointed at her bag, which was lying on the ground, its contents scattered about.
sentences.zh: 她指着地上的包，里面的东西散落一地。

sentences.en: Just as she went to collect her things, John noticed a small pack lying in the doorway.
sentences.zh: 就在她去捡东西时，约翰注意到门洞里有一个小包。

sentences.en: It was a haversack, which was a type of bag typically carried by military personnel.
sentences.zh: 那是一个帆布背包，通常是军事人员携带的那种。

sentences.en: Inside was a gas mask.
sentences.zh: 里面装着一个防毒面具。

sentences.en: While the constant fear of being bombed loomed over Londoners, the average person was far more worried about a chemical gas attack.
sentences.zh: 虽然伦敦人一直笼罩在被轰炸的恐惧中，但普通民众更担心的是化学毒气袭击。

sentences.en: Potentially fatal mustard gas had been deployed during World War I, and there was a genuine fear it might be used against civilians again.
sentences.zh: 第一次世界大战中曾使用过可能致命的芥子气，人们确实担心它会再次被用于平民。

sentences.en: As a precautionary measure, the London County Council suggested that civilians carry a gas mask with them at all times.
sentences.zh: 作为预防措施，伦敦郡议会建议平民随身携带防毒面具。

sentences.en: John Shine picked the gas mask up off the ground and asked Mary if it was hers.
sentences.zh: 约翰·沙因从地上捡起防毒面具，问玛丽是不是她的。

sentences.en: She said no.
sentences.zh: 她说不是。

sentences.en: Mary Haywood had survived an encounter with the Blackout Ripper.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·海伍德在与“灯火管制开膛手”的遭遇中幸存了下来。

sentences.en: After taking her statement, the attending officer collected the haversack and gas mask that the killer had left behind.
sentences.zh: 在记录下她的口供后，在场警官收走了凶手留下的帆布背包和防毒面具。

sentences.en: Printed on the bag's inside flap was a Royal Air Force number.
sentences.zh: 包的内盖上印着一个英国皇家空军的编号。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Fighter Pilot, the words convey something of the spirit that lies in our squadrons.
sentences.zh: 战斗机飞行员，这几个字传达了我们中队所蕴含的一种精神。

sentences.en: Something young and vigorous, decisive, wanting action at once, and finding its expression in the struggle going on daily over our southeastern shores.
sentences.zh: 一种年轻、充满活力、果断、渴望立即行动的精神，并在我们东南海岸每天进行的斗争中得到了体现。

sentences.en: But you have not yet been let into the mind of the men who do the flying, nor shown their feelings when in the air and going into a fight.
sentences.zh: 但你还没有深入了解那些飞行员的内心，也没有看到他们在空中进入战斗时的感受。

sentences.en: The long periods of waiting are a test of temperament.
sentences.zh: 漫长的等待是对性情的考验。

sentences.en: Some pilots occupy themselves actively.
sentences.zh: 有些飞行员会让自己忙碌起来。

sentences.en: Others pass the time in sleep.
sentences.zh: 其他人则在睡眠中打发时间。

sentences.en: Corporal Charles Johnson of the Royal Air Force was stationed at the Aircrew Receiving Centre at St James Close in Regent's Park.
sentences.zh: 英国皇家空军的查尔斯·约翰逊下士当时驻扎在摄政公园圣詹姆斯大厦的机组人员接待中心。

sentences.en: At 10.30 that Friday night, the phone rang.
sentences.zh: 那个周五晚上十点半，电话响了。

sentences.en: On the other end was a police officer.
sentences.zh: 电话那头是一位警官。

sentences.en: I need you to search records and trace the number of an airman, Corporal Johnson was told.
sentences.zh: “我需要你查询记录并追踪一名飞行员的编号，”约翰逊下士被告知。

sentences.en: He grabbed a pen.
sentences.zh: 他抓起一支笔。

sentences.en: The number was allotted to leading aircraftman, 28-year-old Gordon Cummins.
sentences.zh: 该编号分配给了28岁的首席飞行员戈登·卡明斯。

sentences.en: Cummins had arrived at the centre on February 2 to begin training as a fighter pilot.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯于2月2日抵达该中心，开始接受战斗机飞行员训练。

sentences.en: A week later, Evelyn Hamilton was murdered in a bomb shelter less than half a mile away.
sentences.zh: 一周后，伊芙琳·汉密尔顿在不到半英里外的一个防空洞中被谋杀。

sentences.en: Corporal Johnson went to inform Cummins that the police wished to speak to him, but he was nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊下士去通知卡明斯警方想找他谈话，但他却不见踪影。

sentences.en: A 10.30pm curfew was in place for cadets, but it wasn't until 4.30am that Cummins was spotted trying to sneak into his living quarters.
sentences.zh: 学员们有晚上十点半的宵禁，但直到凌晨四点半，卡明斯才被发现试图溜回宿舍。

sentences.en: He apologised, explaining that he'd been drinking heavily and had trouble making it back in time.
sentences.zh: 他道歉并解释说自己喝多了，没能及时赶回来。

sentences.en: It wasn't particularly unusual for cadets to break curfew as they often ventured into the city at night to let off steam and overindulge.
sentences.zh: 学员违反宵禁并不罕见，因为他们经常在晚上去城里放松和过度饮酒。

sentences.en: When Cummins was informed that his gas mask had been found at the scene of a crime, he seemed confused.
sentences.zh: 当卡明斯被告知他的防毒面具在犯罪现场被发现时，他显得很困惑。

sentences.en: He had his haversack with him, with his gas mask inside.
sentences.zh: 他随身带着帆布背包，里面装着他的防毒面具。

sentences.en: However, the number inside the bag confirmed it wasn't his.
sentences.zh: 然而，包里的编号证实那不是他的。

sentences.en: Cummins then realised what must have happened.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯随后意识到发生了什么。

sentences.en: He'd been drinking at a pub with other cadets and had placed his haversack by his feet alongside the others.
sentences.zh: 他当时和几名学员在酒吧喝酒，把帆布背包放在脚边，和其他人的放在一起。

sentences.en: Someone must have taken his by mistake.
sentences.zh: 一定是有人拿错了他的包。

sentences.en: The heavily intoxicated Cummins couldn't remember exactly who had joined him that night, and of those he could remember, he didn't know their names.
sentences.zh: 醉醺醺的卡明斯记不清那天晚上都有谁和他在一起，即使记得的人，他也不知道他们的名字。

sentences.en: But he was confident he'd be able to recognise them if he saw them again.
sentences.zh: 但他确信如果再见到他们，他一定能认出来。

sentences.en: Cummins was taken to the West End Central Police Station where he was directly questioned about Mary Haywood.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯被带到西区中央警察局，直接接受了关于玛丽·海伍德案件的审讯。

sentences.en: The two had been drinking at the same Piccadilly Circus pub prior to Mary's attack.
sentences.zh: 在玛丽遇袭前，两人曾在同一家皮卡迪利广场的酒吧喝过酒。

sentences.en: Cummins spoke of having a hazy recollection of walking around the streets with a woman, but was too drunk to remember what happened after that.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯说他隐约记得和一个女人在街上走，但喝得太醉，记不清之后发生了什么。

sentences.en: He denied attacking Mary, saying,
sentences.zh: 他否认袭击了玛丽，说道：

sentences.en: I remembered I should be back at my depot.
sentences.zh: “我记得我应该回我的驻地。”

sentences.en: I caught a cab and went to Regent's Park.
sentences.zh: “我叫了辆出租车去了摄政公园。”

sentences.en: Cummins agreed to provide a written statement, during which detectives noticed that he wrote with his left hand.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯同意提供书面陈述，期间侦探们注意到他用左手写字。

sentences.en: There were also fresh abrasions across his knuckles, which Cummins claimed had occurred when he was working on an aeroplane motor.
sentences.zh: 他的指关节上还有新鲜的擦伤，卡明斯声称那是他在修理飞机引擎时弄伤的。

sentences.en: When asked to view a police line-up that featured Cummins, Mary Haywood unhesitantly identified him as the man who had assaulted her.
sentences.zh: 当被要求观看包含卡明斯的警察列队辨认时，玛丽·海伍德毫不犹豫地指认他就是袭击自己的人。

sentences.en: Cummins maintained his innocence, stating that Mary must have confused him with another airman who was attempting to frame him.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯坚称自己无罪，称玛丽一定把他和另一个试图陷害他的飞行员搞混了。

sentences.en: Detectives were unconvinced by his story and placed him under arrest for assault.
sentences.zh: 侦探们对他的说辞并不信服，以袭击罪将他逮捕。

sentences.en: Inside Cummins' pockets, police found an array of miscellaneous and seemingly trivial items, including a plastic comb with some teeth missing,
sentences.zh: 在卡明斯的口袋里，警方发现了一系列杂乱且看似琐碎的物品，包括一把缺了齿的塑料梳子，

sentences.en: a fountain-tip pen engraved with the initials DJ, and a wristwatch with a broken band that had been repaired with tape.
sentences.zh: 一支刻有DJ首字母的钢笔，以及一块表带断裂并用胶带修复过的手表。

sentences.en: He also had a strip of paper with a number on it.
sentences.zh: 他还带有一张写着数字的纸条。

sentences.en: It was Mary Haywood's phone number, scrawled in her handwriting.
sentences.zh: 那是玛丽·海伍德的电话号码，上面是她的笔迹。

sentences.en: She had told police that she'd given it to her assailant prior to the attack.
sentences.zh: 她曾告诉警方，她在遇袭前把号码给了袭击者。

sentences.en: The question remained, was Gordon Cummins the blackout ripper?
sentences.zh: 问题依然存在：戈登·卡明斯是“灯火管制开膛手”吗？

sentences.en: Evidence had pointed to the four-time killer being in some way connected to the Royal Air Force.
sentences.zh: 证据表明这名四次杀人凶手与英国皇家空军有某种联系。

sentences.en: The man who had attempted to strangle Catherine Mulcahy in her apartment had left behind an item of clothing as he scrambled around in the dark trying to get dressed before fleeing.
sentences.zh: 那个曾试图在公寓里勒死凯瑟琳·穆尔卡希的男人，在黑暗中慌乱穿衣逃跑时，留下了一件衣物。

sentences.en: It was a belt which was part of the Royal Air Force uniform.
sentences.zh: 那是一条属于英国皇家空军制服的腰带。

sentences.en: This aligned with the recollections of the other women who had interacted with the ripper.
sentences.zh: 这与曾与开膛手接触过的其他女性的回忆相吻合。

sentences.en: They all said he claimed to be an airman.
sentences.zh: 她们都说他自称是一名飞行员。

sentences.en: Positioned at the entry hall of the St James Close Aircrew Receiving Centre was a logbook.
sentences.zh: 在圣詹姆斯大厦机组人员接待中心的入口大厅处放着一本登记簿。

sentences.en: Cadets were required to record the time they left and returned each day, with an orderly stationed at the logbook to ensure that everyone complied.
sentences.zh: 学员们每天必须记录离开和返回的时间，并由一名值班人员看守登记簿以确保每个人都遵守规定。

sentences.en: A detective flipped through the book to the dates and time periods that Evelyn Hamilton,
sentences.zh: 一名侦探翻阅了登记簿，查看伊芙琳·汉密尔顿、

sentences.en: Evelyn Oatley, Doris Duanet and Margaret Lowe were killed.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳·奥特利、多丽丝·杜安内特和玛格丽特·洛被杀的日期和时间段。

sentences.en: To his surprise, Gordon Cummins' name was signed in on each occasion, meaning he was at the centre when each woman was targeted.
sentences.zh: 令他惊讶的是，戈登·卡明斯的名字在每次案发时都有登记，这意味着每名受害者遇害时他都在中心。

sentences.en: Yet, something stood out.
sentences.zh: 然而，有些地方很可疑。

sentences.en: While some of the logbook entries were penned in ink, others had been scrawled in pencil.
sentences.zh: 虽然登记簿上的一些条目是用墨水写的，但另一些却是用铅笔潦草写下的。

sentences.en: All of Cummins' entries coinciding with the time of the murders were in pencil, meaning they could have easily been altered.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯所有与谋杀时间吻合的条目都是用铅笔写的，这意味着它们很容易被篡改。

sentences.en: In some cases, they were written in a different pencil to all the others on the page.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，它们所用的铅笔与页面上其他条目的铅笔不同。

sentences.en: An entire page from that week was also missing, with the entries from another date copied into its place.
sentences.zh: 那一周的整整一页也不见了，取而代之的是从其他日期复制过来的条目。

sentences.en: The detective wrote in his report,
sentences.zh: 侦探在报告中写道：

sentences.en: According to the cadets who bunked with Cummins, he often stayed out past curfew and snuck back in before dawn.
sentences.zh: 据与卡明斯同住的学员说，他经常在宵禁后不归，直到黎明前才溜回来。

sentences.en: When he went out with others, Cummins would sometimes go off on his own.
sentences.zh: 当他和别人一起出去时，卡明斯有时会独自离开。

sentences.en: It was no secret that he was out seeking sex workers.
sentences.zh: 他外出寻找性工作者早已不是什么秘密。

sentences.en: Cummins, with his unruly wavy blonde hair, trimmed moustache, narrow facial features and wide smile, was considered an attractive man who often bragged about his conquests.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯留着凌乱的波浪状金发，修剪整齐的胡须，面部轮廓狭窄，笑容灿烂，被认为是一个很有吸引力的男人，经常吹嘘自己的猎艳战绩。

sentences.en: He had earned the reputation amongst his fellow cadets as being a ladies' man and a party animal.
sentences.zh: 他在学员中赢得了“情圣”和“派对狂”的名声。

sentences.en: Women were often charmed by his looks, intellect and refined British accent, as it reflected nobility and wealth.
sentences.zh: 女性常被他的外表、才智和优雅的英国口音所吸引，因为这反映了高贵的出身和财富。

sentences.en: A search of the trash cans outside of the aircrew receiving centre's entrance resulted in an unusual find.
sentences.zh: 对机组人员接待中心门外的垃圾桶进行搜查时，有一个不同寻常的发现。

sentences.en: The soles of two shoes with a distinctive tread pattern.
sentences.zh: 两只鞋底，上面有独特的纹路图案。

sentences.en: Back at the police station, Gordon Cummins was asked to show detectives the soles of his shoes.
sentences.zh: 回到警察局，戈登·卡明斯被要求向侦探展示他的鞋底。

sentences.en: Surprised, he lifted his feet for the detective to see.
sentences.zh: 他感到惊讶，抬起脚让侦探查看。

sentences.en: The tops of his soles had been replaced with a new tread.
sentences.zh: 他鞋底的顶部已经被换成了新的纹路。

sentences.en: Although no discernible boot prints had been uncovered at any of the crime scenes,
sentences.zh: 尽管在任何犯罪现场都没有发现清晰的鞋印，

sentences.en: detectives theorised that Cummins had changed the soles out of fear that their unusual pattern might be traced back to him.
sentences.zh: 但侦探们推测，卡明斯是因为担心其独特的图案会被追查到自己身上，才更换了鞋底。

sentences.en: When asked to explain why he had recently changed the soles of his shoes, Cummins just shrugged his shoulders.
sentences.zh: 当被问及为何最近更换鞋底时，卡明斯只是耸了耸肩。

sentences.en: The aircrew receiving centre was searched extensively, revealing a significant item in the very back of a cupboard in the shared kitchenette.
sentences.zh: 机组人员接待中心经过了彻底搜查，在公共小厨房的一个橱柜最深处发现了一件重要物品。

sentences.en: It was a white metal cigarette case engraved with the initials LW.
sentences.zh: 那是一个刻有LW首字母的白金属烟盒。

sentences.en: Inside was a photograph of a woman.
sentences.zh: 里面有一张女人的照片。

sentences.en: It didn't resemble any of the victims, but when shown to their loved ones, Evelyn Oatley's former husband identified the case as belonging to his actress wife,
sentences.zh: 它看起来不像任何受害者，但当展示给她们的亲人看时，伊芙琳·奥特利的前夫认出这个烟盒属于他那当演员的妻子，

sentences.en: who used the stage name Lita Ward.
sentences.zh: 她使用丽塔·沃德这个艺名。

sentences.en: The photograph inside was of her mother.
sentences.zh: 里面的照片是她的母亲。

sentences.en: Detectives showed the items found in Gordon Cummins' pockets to the victims' families.
sentences.zh: 侦探们向受害者家属展示了在戈登·卡明斯口袋里发现的物品。

sentences.en: Doris Duannet's husband, Henry, immediately recognised the comb, fountain pen and wristwatch as having belonged to Doris.
sentences.zh: 多丽丝·杜安内特的丈夫亨利一眼就认出那把梳子、钢笔和手表属于多丽丝。

sentences.en: A connection was also established to Evelyn Hamilton via a green lead pencil that was found in a dustbin in Cummins' living quarters.
sentences.zh: 通过在卡明斯宿舍垃圾桶里发现的一支绿色铅笔，也建立了与伊芙琳·汉密尔顿的联系。

sentences.en: She had borrowed it from a friend shortly before her murder.
sentences.zh: 她在谋杀前不久从朋友那里借了这支笔。

sentences.en: The night after Evelyn was killed, Cummins was seen flashing a large amount of money.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳被杀后的第二天晚上，有人看到卡明斯挥霍大量现金。

sentences.en: Given that around 80 pounds was stolen from Evelyn's purse, this had likely been her money.
sentences.zh: 考虑到伊芙琳的钱包里被偷走了大约80英镑，这很可能就是她的钱。

sentences.en: Two £1 notes that the blackout ripper had tossed at Catherine Mulcahy featured serial numbers that were traced back to cash that was paid to Gordon Cummins earlier that day.
sentences.zh: “灯火管制开膛手”扔给凯瑟琳·穆尔卡希的两张1英镑纸币，其序列号被追溯到当天早些时候支付给戈登·卡明斯的现金。

sentences.en: Traces of blood were found on Cummins' clothing, but restraints in scientific testing meant it couldn't be compared to the blood of the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯的衣服上发现了血迹，但由于科学检测的限制，无法将其与受害者的血液进行比对。

sentences.en: Yet, there was one test that could provide investigators with a smoking gun.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一项检测能为调查人员提供确凿的证据。

sentences.en: Detective Chief Superintendent Frederick Cherrill had been working the blackout ripper case since the murder of Evelyn Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 刑事侦缉总督察弗雷德里克·切里尔自伊芙琳·汉密尔顿遇害以来，就一直负责调查“灯火管制开膛手”案。

sentences.en: Cherrill was the head of Scotland Yard's fingerprint division and regarded the country's leading fingerprint expert.
sentences.zh: 切里尔是苏格兰场指纹部门的负责人，被公认为全国顶尖的指纹专家。

sentences.en: He had managed to lift several key fingerprints from two of the ripper's crime scenes.
sentences.zh: 他成功从开膛手作案的两处现场提取到了几枚关键指纹。

sentences.en: Two were uncovered in Evelyn Oatley's apartment.
sentences.zh: 其中两枚是在伊芙琳·奥特利的公寓里发现的。

sentences.en: One was on the can opener that was used to mutilate her and the other on a piece of glass in her purse.
sentences.zh: 一枚在用于残害她的开罐器上，另一枚在她钱包里的一块玻璃片上。

sentences.en: He'd also found foreign fingerprints on a candle holder in Margaret Lowe's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 他还曾在玛格丽特·洛卧室的烛台上发现了外人的指纹。

sentences.en: It had held the candle that was later found inside her body.
sentences.zh: 那上面插着后来在玛格丽特体内发现的蜡烛。

sentences.en: Gordon Cummins' fingerprints were taken upon his arrest and Detective Cherrill cross-checked them against those from the crime scenes.
sentences.zh: 戈登·卡明斯被捕后被采集了指纹，切里尔探长将这些指纹与案发现场的指纹进行了交叉比对。

sentences.en: They were a match.
sentences.zh: 结果吻合。

sentences.en: Furthermore, traces of mortar on Cummins' haversack matched that found in the bomb shelter where Evelyn Hamilton was murdered.
sentences.zh: 此外，卡明斯帆布包上的砂浆痕迹与伊芙琳·汉密尔顿遇害的防空洞内发现的砂浆相吻合。

sentences.en: Gordon Cummins was ultimately charged with the murders of Evelyn Hamilton, Evelyn Oatley, Doris Joannett, Margaret Lowe,
sentences.zh: 戈登·卡明斯最终被控谋杀伊芙琳·汉密尔顿、伊芙琳·奥特利、多丽丝·乔内特、玛格丽特·洛，

sentences.en: and the attempted murders of Catherine Mulcahy and Mary Haywood.
sentences.zh: 以及企图谋杀凯瑟琳·马尔卡希和玛丽·海伍德。

sentences.en: He was examined by a medical officer to determine if he was suffering from any mental illness that might have influenced his violent behaviour.
sentences.zh: 一名医务官对他进行了检查，以确定他是否患有任何可能影响其暴力行为的精神疾病。

sentences.en: The doctor concluded,
sentences.zh: 医生总结道：

sentences.en: The character and sights of the wounds inflicted on the victims points to a sadistic basis for the murders.
sentences.zh: 受害者伤口的特征和样貌表明，这些谋杀案具有虐待狂倾向。

sentences.en: But throughout the period he has been in my care, the accused has been normal in conduct and rational in conversation.
sentences.zh: 但在我照看他的这段时间里，被告的行为举止正常，谈吐理性。

sentences.en: At no time has he exhibited any evidence of mental disease.
sentences.zh: 他从未表现出任何精神疾病的迹象。

sentences.en: This assessment aligned with those who knew Cummins.
sentences.zh: 这一评估与认识卡明斯的人的看法一致。

sentences.en: While some found him vain and pompous, he had never shown a dark side or a disdain for women.
sentences.zh: 虽然有些人觉得他虚荣且自负，但他从未表现出阴暗面或对女性的蔑视。

sentences.en: His father described him as a normal person, without any cruelty in his nature.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲形容他是一个正常人，天性中没有任何残忍之处。

sentences.en: Superior officers praised his military discipline and physical abilities, which surpassed his fellow cadets.
sentences.zh: 上级长官称赞他的军事纪律和身体素质，称其超越了同期的学员。

sentences.en: Sex workers he'd been with didn't describe him as aggressive.
sentences.zh: 与他有过往来的性工作者也没有说他有攻击性。

sentences.en: Cummins also had a wife who steadfastly defended him.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯还有一位坚定地为他辩护的妻子。

sentences.en: Yet, some noted that he had a gift for storytelling that would convince listeners that whatever he was saying was the truth.
sentences.zh: 然而，有人指出他有一种讲故事的天赋，能让听众相信他所说的任何话都是事实。

sentences.en: He was also caught lying about his whereabouts on the night of the murders, claiming he had alibis that were later disproven.
sentences.zh: 他还被发现就谋杀案当晚的行踪撒谎，声称自己有不在场证明，但后来被证实是假的。

sentences.en: English law dictated that if someone was facing multiple criminal counts, they only faced trial for one.
sentences.zh: 英国法律规定，如果某人面临多项刑事指控，他们只需接受其中一项的审判。

sentences.en: Therefore, in April 1942, Cummins was tried for the murder of Evelyn Oatley.
sentences.zh: 因此，1942年4月，卡明斯因谋杀伊芙琳·奥特利而受审。

sentences.en: The prosecution felt they were more likely to secure a guilty verdict with this charge,
sentences.zh: 检方认为，这项指控更有可能获得有罪判决，

sentences.en: as it was the only one in which Cummins' fingerprints were found on an item directly used to assault the victim.
sentences.zh: 因为这是唯一一项在直接用于袭击受害者的物品上发现了卡明斯指纹的指控。

sentences.en: Cummins pleaded not guilty and appeared his typical happy and relaxed self throughout proceedings, even laughing with his lawyers.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯拒不认罪，在整个诉讼过程中表现得一如既往地快乐和放松，甚至与律师谈笑风生。

sentences.en: When he took the stand, Cummins admitted he had been in Evelyn Oatley's company shortly before her murder, but insisted she was alive and well when they parted ways.
sentences.zh: 当他出庭作证时，卡明斯承认在伊芙琳·奥特利遇害前不久曾与她在一起，但坚称他们分开时她还活着，身体状况良好。

sentences.en: He had told this information to police, but to Cummins' dismay, they immediately accused him of being Evelyn's killer.
sentences.zh: 他曾向警方提供过这一信息，但令卡明斯沮丧的是，警方立即指控他是伊芙琳的凶手。

sentences.en: Cummins said one officer remarked,
sentences.zh: 卡明斯说，一名警官曾评论道：

sentences.en: The officer who Cummins accused of making this threat denied it wholeheartedly.
sentences.zh: 被卡明斯指控发出这种威胁的警官全盘否认了此事。

sentences.en: The prosecution's case rested primarily on the fingerprint evidence, as it showed Cummins had handled the sharp can opener used to mutilate Evelyn's genitals.
sentences.zh: 检方的案件主要基于指纹证据，因为它表明卡明斯接触过用于残害伊芙琳生殖器的锋利开罐器。

sentences.en: The defence worked to discredit the prints, calling them very faint and imperfect.
sentences.zh: 辩方试图推翻这些指纹，称其非常模糊且不完整。

sentences.en: Renowned fingerprint expert Detective Chief Superintendent Frederick Cherrill stood by his findings.
sentences.zh: 著名的指纹专家、刑事侦缉总督察弗雷德里克·切里尔坚持自己的调查结果。

sentences.en: He was asked,
sentences.zh: 有人问他：

sentences.en: Would you stake your reputation knowing that a man is being tried for his life?
sentences.zh: 你是否愿意拿你的名誉作赌注，明知一个人正面临死刑审判？

sentences.en: Without hesitation, Cherrill responded,
sentences.zh: 切里尔毫不犹豫地回答：

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The jury deliberated for only 35 minutes before returning to the courtroom, where Cummins stood before them with fists clenched.
sentences.zh: 陪审团仅审议了35分钟就回到了法庭，卡明斯握紧双拳站在他们面前。

sentences.en: The presiding judge summed up that the murder of Evelyn Oatley was,
sentences.zh: 主审法官总结称，伊芙琳·奥特利的谋杀案是：

sentences.en: A sadistic sexual murder of a ghoulish type.
sentences.zh: 一种令人毛骨悚然的虐待狂性谋杀。

sentences.en: Gordon Cummins was found guilty.
sentences.zh: 戈登·卡明斯被判有罪。

sentences.en: When asked if he had anything to say, Cummins stuttered,
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否有话要说时，卡明斯结结巴巴地说：

sentences.en: I am completely innocent, sir.
sentences.zh: 我是完全无辜的，长官。

sentences.en: The judge then donned a square black cap that historically was only ever worn by English judges when delivering the following sentence.
sentences.zh: 法官随后戴上了一顶方形黑帽，按照惯例，这顶帽子只有在英国法官宣判以下判决时才会佩戴。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述如下：

sentences.en: There is only one sentence which the law permits me to pronounce, and that is that you be taken to a place of execution,
sentences.zh: 法律只允许我宣判一种刑罚，那就是将你带往行刑地，

sentences.en: and that you be there hanged by the neck until you are dead.
sentences.zh: 并在那里处以绞刑，直至死亡。

sentences.en: And may the Lord have mercy on your soul.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝怜悯你的灵魂。

sentences.en: In the lead up to his execution, Gordon Cummins exhausted all avenues of appeal.
sentences.zh: 在被处决前，戈登·卡明斯穷尽了所有的上诉途径。

sentences.en: His family believed in his innocence and wrote to the Home Secretary claiming it was a miscarriage of justice.
sentences.zh: 他的家人相信他是无辜的，并写信给内政大臣，称这是一起司法不公。

sentences.en: A petition supporting Cummins received 10,000 signatures, with his supporters highlighting his lack of violent history and clean criminal record.
sentences.zh: 一份支持卡明斯的请愿书获得了1万个签名，支持者们强调他没有暴力史，且犯罪记录清白。

sentences.en: They questioned how someone so straight and narrow could abruptly begin killing women in such an immensely violent and personal way.
sentences.zh: 他们质疑一个如此循规蹈矩的人怎么会突然开始以如此极其暴力和私人的方式杀害女性。

sentences.en: The Home Secretary wrote the same response to all letters.
sentences.zh: 内政大臣给所有信件写了同样的回复。

sentences.en: I have considered sympathetically and carefully all the circumstances of the case.
sentences.zh: 我已经同情且仔细地考虑了案件的所有情况。

sentences.en: I regret I have failed to discover any grounds which justify me in advising His Majesty to interfere in the due course of the law.
sentences.zh: 我很遗憾未能发现任何理由，能证明我建议国王干预法律的正当程序是合理的。

sentences.en: In October 1941, just four months before Evelyn Hamilton was killed,
sentences.zh: 1941年10月，就在伊芙琳·汉密尔顿遇害前四个月，

sentences.en: the body of 19-year-old Maple Church was found in the wreckage of a building destroyed by overhead bombings in London's Camden Town.
sentences.zh: 19岁的梅普尔·丘奇的尸体在伦敦卡姆登镇被空袭摧毁的一栋建筑废墟中被发现。

sentences.en: Maple had been strangled with her undergarments as well as mutilated.
sentences.zh: 梅普尔被自己的内衣勒死，并遭到残害。

sentences.en: Analysis of the wounds showed the killer was likely left-handed.
sentences.zh: 对伤口的分析显示，凶手很可能是左撇子。

sentences.en: Maple had also been robbed.
sentences.zh: 梅普尔还遭到了抢劫。

sentences.en: Four days after Maple's body was discovered, the unconscious body of 49-year-old Edith Humphreys was found lying across her bed in her flat just half a mile away.
sentences.zh: 在梅普尔的尸体被发现四天后，49岁的伊迪丝·汉弗莱斯不省人事的身体被发现躺在距离半英里外公寓的床上。

sentences.en: Her skull had been fractured with a penetrating stab wound to her brain and her jaw was broken.
sentences.zh: 她的头骨骨折，大脑有穿透性刺伤，下颚骨折。

sentences.en: There were also signs she had been manually strangled.
sentences.zh: 还有迹象表明她曾被人用手勒过。

sentences.en: Edith was still clinging to life and was rushed to hospital, but died of her injuries later that day.
sentences.zh: 伊迪丝当时还有一口气，被紧急送往医院，但当天晚些时候因伤势过重死亡。

sentences.en: Reports differ, but many say that Edith had been robbed, with jewellery and money missing.
sentences.zh: 报道各不相同，但许多人说伊迪丝遭到了抢劫，珠宝和钱财不翼而飞。

sentences.en: With no signs of forced entry, it appeared she had willingly let her killer into her home.
sentences.zh: 由于没有强行闯入的迹象，看来她是自愿让凶手进入家门的。

sentences.en: A background check showed that Gordon Cummins was in the area when the murders of Maple Church and Edith Humphreys took place.
sentences.zh: 背景调查显示，梅普尔·丘奇和伊迪丝·汉弗莱斯遇害时，戈登·卡明斯就在附近。

sentences.en: Despite intensive investigations, both cases remained unsolved.
sentences.zh: 尽管进行了深入调查，这两起案件仍未侦破。

sentences.en: Yet, given their similarities to the Blackout Ripper's known crimes, many have theorised that Maple and Edith might have been his first victiMs.
sentences.zh: 然而，鉴于它们与“灯火管制开膛手”已知罪行的相似之处，许多人推测梅普尔和伊迪丝可能是他的第一批受害者。

sentences.en: To this day, Scotland Yard strongly believes Gordon Cummins was responsible for these crimes.
sentences.zh: 时至今日，苏格兰场仍坚信戈登·卡明斯应对这些罪行负责。

sentences.en: The man himself would never lay claim to any of the murders he was accused of, maintaining his innocence up until June 1942, when he was led to the hangman's noose.
sentences.zh: 他本人从未承认过任何被指控的谋杀案，直到1942年6月被带往绞刑架前，他一直坚称自己无辜。

sentences.en: He offered no resistance and appeared stoic when the rope was placed around his neck.
sentences.zh: 当绳索套在脖子上时，他没有反抗，表现得很镇定。

sentences.en: Gordon Cummins was pronounced dead minutes after 8am to the tune of an air raid siren blasting over London.
sentences.zh: 戈登·卡明斯在早上8点过后几分钟被宣布死亡，伴随着伦敦上空响起的空袭警报声。

sentences.en: At that exact time, city dwellers huddled nervously in makeshift shelters, listening for the sound of encroaching German aeroplanes.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，城市居民紧张地蜷缩在临时避难所里，听着德国飞机逼近的声音。

sentences.en: For Londoners, their fears had returned to the war, now that the Blackout Ripper was no longer lurking in the night.
sentences.zh: 对于伦敦人来说，随着“灯火管制开膛手”不再潜伏在夜色中，他们对战争的恐惧又回来了。

sentences.en: We can definitely tell you that.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对可以告诉你这一点。

sentences.en: All right!
sentences.zh: 好的！

sentences.en: Let's get started.
sentences.zh: 让我们开始吧。
